fusions.name: Turned Soil Burst
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 12 damage and is stunned for 1 second. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Burrowing Barb
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A thrust that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Entrenched
fusions.desc: When you strike, your damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
